children: Trump Touts Lower Prices
Trump said Republicans had "won the presidency three times," although he won the 2016 and 2024 elections and lost in 2020.
He also stated that food prices and "almost every other item" were rapidly falling. While egg prices have dropped significantly from their peak, broader consumer prices have continued to rise.
The latest available inflation data, for July, showed prices rising 3.4% year over year, above the 2.9% rate recorded in December 2024, former President
Joe Biden’s
last full month in office, and the 3.0% rate reported in January 2025, CNN noted.
Trump Promises $5,000 ‘Dividend’
Trump also promised that every adult American could receive $5,000 if Republicans retain control of Congress, calling it a "Trump dividend."
He did not provide details on how he would fund or implement such payments.
Trump has compared the latest proposal to dividends companies pay shareholders and likened it to the $1,776 payments given to U.S. service members last year.
"If the Republicans win, you win with us and you get $5,000," Trump said. "It will be called the Trump dividend."
The President had previously proposed $2,000 tariff rebate checks for most Americans, but his Treasury secretary said such payments would require congressional legislation, CNN stated.
Trump Touts $20 Trillion in US Investments
Trump said more than $20 trillion had been invested in the U.S. during his second term and suggested the figure could eventually reach $25 trillion.
The White House has cited $11.2 trillion in major investment announcements.

The White House’s investment tally included vague trade and economic commitments rather than direct U.S. investments, while federal data showed about $232 billion in new foreign direct investment in 2025, an October CNN review reported.
